summary: On 16 April 2026 someone who said he was a police officer kept the victim on a video call for hours, and the victim then moved money out of their account. You have the victim's WhatsApp messages of that day (all chats in one file, in time order), the call log, and the officer's ID-card photo as the victim received it. Everything here is synthetic.

questions.text: Who told the victim to transfer money to the 'safe account'?
Was the officer's ID-card photo edited after it was taken?
